kim: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands security segment. Putting unanswered Qs here so we can track owners.
nora: Thanks. First: our SOC2 auditors asked where the exported evidence bundle is stored and how to verify it hasn't been tampered with.
felix: Short answer: bundles are written to a per-tenant encrypted bucket with object immutability option. We'll include a signed manifest and a sha256 hash.
rachael: Will the manifest contain who requested the export and the reason? Auditors want context.
felix: Yes. Manifest fields: bundle_id, requested_by, request_ticket, purpose, timestamp, sha256, signer_id. Example: ```{
  "bundle_id": "bndl-2278001111-01",
  "requested_by": "nora",
  "request_ticket": "ENG-4123",
  "purpose": "SOC2 audit",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-02T14:10:05Z",
  "sha256": "<hex>",
  "signer_id": "redwood-svc-2026-v1"
}```
nora: Good. Next: KMS rotation history  can customers see rotation timeline and actor?
felix: Cloud KMS keys: yes, rotation timestamps + principal id are returned by the control plane API. For BYOK/HSM we will include vendor attestation files in the bundle (format TBD).
rachael: Ops asked whether HSM BYOK will delay audits because of vendor formats. We need a standardized attestation schema.
kim: Action: felix to propose an attestation schema that can be included in the evidence bundle.
felix: I can draft a minimal JSON attestation with fields: key_id, rotation_time, attestor_vendor, attestation_doc_url.
ops-bot: Notice: evidence-bundle-service v3.0 deployed by felix at 2278001180. :rocket: 
nora: VPC flow logs: can customers stream flow logs into their SIEM and keep provenance?
felix: Yes. We support pushing flow logs to customer destinations (S3, HTTP(S) endpoint, syslog). We'll provide an IAM role template for AWS and a signed endpoint pattern for on-prem.
rachael: Please add sample least-privilege IAM policy + a snippet to the docs.
kim: Owners and due dates so we can close: 
- Publish evidence export FAQ + storage details (owner: nora, due: 2026-07-10)
- Implement signed manifest + sha256 (owner: felix, due: 2026-07-14)
- Attestation schema for HSM BYOK (owner: felix, due: 2026-07-21)
- Flow log export guide + IAM samples (owner: rachael, due: 2026-07-08)
- Add bundle download provenance to console (owner: kim, due: 2026-07-18)
legal-bot: Reminder: any public-facing retention statements require legal review. Please add tag `legal-review` to PRs.
nora: Can we confirm default retention tiers? Auditors asked for numbers.
felix: Current defaults: 1y hot, 3y cold, with enterprise contract options up to 10y archive. We'll include explicit numbers in the FAQ.
rachael: UX ask: console should show `bundle provenance` (requested_by, signed_by, download_log). I'll add a mockup to the backlog.
kim: Small implementation note: export CLI will have `--attach-manifest` flag; backend will emit an audit event for manifest creation. Example: ```redwood export --from s3://audit-2026/2026-07-02.gz --attach-manifest --out ./evidence/```
ops-bot: Reminder: create ticket `evidence-provenance-ui` and link it back to this thread.
kim: Perfect. I'll consolidate into a short Confluence doc and ping everyone when it's live. If legal needs an early draft, tag legal-bot.
rachael: Thanks all.
felix: :thumbsup:
